about: DNS for promptugal.news (Route 53 hosted zone Z0663369UQ6WKN4WWZBK), as code. DNS apply only CREATES a record listed here that the zone lacks. It never changes or deletes a record: one that exists with a different value is reported for Dinis. The apex (its A, TXT and other records) is never written: the AWS role allows only names under *.promptugal.news.
